ios.desc:
10 – The Daily Numbers Challenge
Sharpen your mind, challenge your creativity, and join players around the world in the daily numbers puzzle that’s simple to learn but hard to master!

How It Works:
Every day, you receive the same four digits and one goal: create an equation that equals 10 using each number exactly once. It’s a fresh puzzle daily, designed to make you think critically, experiment, and grow your problem-solving skills.

Features:
Daily Puzzles: A new set of digits every day for all players.
Track Your Streaks: Consistency is key—keep your streak going to see your progress.
Hints & Guidance: Optional hints help you when you’re stuck, but the challenge is yours to solve.
PRO Subscription: Unlock unlimited hints and enhanced gameplay tools for a deeper experience.
Shared Experience: Play the exact same puzzle as everyone else worldwide.

Why 10?
10 is more than just a game. It’s a mental workout that rewards creativity, persistence, and consistency. Whether you play for a few minutes or dive deep into solving strategies, each puzzle helps strengthen your mind.

Pro Subscription Details:
Unlock unlimited hints and extra features.
Billed weekly at $7.99.
Automatic renewal unless canceled via Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Disclaimer:
10 is a game for entertainment and mental engagement. It is not a medical, psychological, or educational tool.
